title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri vows to prove himself as his rival warns Sandhya and admires her resilience. Despite Vetri and the teacher's pleas, Abinaya remains adamant and obtains Sudar's TC.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan escapes Palanivel to secretly marry Anjali at a temple. However, Sakthivel catches them in wedding attire, threatens Senthil and Kathir and exposes their secret marriage.

title: Ayyanar Thunai

title: Super Singer Junior
description: The contestants turn up the energy in Race to Finale Phase 2, battling it out for the finale ticket. Fuelled by confidence, they push ahead with renewed determination.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karthik bashes Sethupathi, sparking Kasthuri's jealousy when Priya invites him to dance. Meanwhile, Madhu offers a stranded Arjun a ride, secretly hurt by his rejection.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 27: VJS Reviews BB Hotel 2.0
description: VJS quizzes the housemates on the rope choices and the re-entered trio's promises. Shama's managerial stint draws mixed views, while Vijay probes on why BB Hotel 2.0 failed.
